title: The Five Levels of AI Use
criterion: Order from most restrictive (no AI at all) to most open (AI as a creative partner)
elements: "You may not use AI at all for this assignment."
"AI may help only with brainstorming and outlining — the final work must be your own writing."
"AI may assist with early drafts, feedback, or generating ideas, but you must critically develop and improve on what it gives you."
"AI may be used extensively, following the guidance provided, to complete parts of this task — you must direct and justify how you used it."
"AI is a core creative partner for this project; you may co-design parts of the assessment itself with your instructor."
